name: Tablet Lite
author: maxt
description: The simplified tablet experience: virtual keyboard, voice input and screen rotation. On-screen wvkbd keyboard (Ctrl/Super/Alt, F-keys, number row, arrows, a ▼ collapse key), voxtype hold-to-talk with Delete/Clear/Enter, a caret pad and a CLI-keys grid, plus 90° rotation and sensor auto-rotate (scale and touch calibration preserved), and a lock-screen keyboard with a floating re-invoke button.

barWidget.description: On-screen keyboard toggle + voice input + 90° rotation and a dedicated sensor auto-rotate toggle
